references.text: Describes a day known as the Lord's Day, where the sun turns to darkness and the moon to blood before the great and dreadful day of the Lord comes.
Refers to cosmic disturbances, including the sun and moon losing their light, as a sign of the Lord's Day.
Speaks of a time when the sun and moon lose their light, and the stars fall from heaven.
Describes a great earthquake where the sun becomes black like a sackcloth made of goat hair, and the moon becomes like blood.
A third of the sun, moon, and stars are struck so that a third of them are darkened.
